rationale: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage; these amount fields are determined post-adjudication and violate the submission-time scoring requirement. Retained only submission-time features (claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, flags, diagnosis, and procedure category). Added model_limitations caveat to write_report per feedback T12-caveat_model_limitations. Elimination of leaking features should resolve the inflated ROC-AUC metrics. All other components unchanged.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set (not available at claim submission, causing leakage). Added model_limitations to report caveats (communication discipline).
